text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the way back from taking Gold City out 
to catch a breath of fresh air—
Doooossshhheeeeyyy!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (BOOOM!)

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: !? What is that deafening sound!?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Huff... puff...! Five more sets to go!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Kawakami!? Are you okay? I just heard a 
huge noise coming from—

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Yes, that is certainly the sound of yoga!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...Is that the sound of yoga?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Fufun, I heard yoga is wonderful for 
beauty! And this is...!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: This is the Menko pose~~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WHAM! PAT-PAT-PAT-PAT-PAT!!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When Kawakami Princess swung her arm down, 
the wild birds all took flight at once...!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...Wait, no way...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Phew. Yoga really does warm up the body, 
doesn't it? Would you like to join in, 
City-san?
choice_data_list: No, that's less like yoga and more like...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
! ...Shh, look, Trainer! Look at that 
girl's feet.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
An open notebook lay on the ground at 
Kawakami Princess's feet.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
There's so much written here. Kawakami 
must have studied extensively to develop 
that form of hers.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"...If we flat out tell her it's not yoga, 
wouldn't that make all her hard work go to 
waste?"
choice_data_list: I think that's a different story.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"...If we flat out tell her it's not yoga, 
wouldn't that make all her hard work go to 
waste?"
choice_data_list: I think that's a different story.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...Thanks.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: ? What is the matter?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"It's nothing. More importantly, I just 
never knew menko had poses like that."

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
You study a whole lot, don't you, 
Kawakami? Could you teach me some stuff 
too?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Oh, my...! Please leave it to me!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, I see. So there is also a Pigeon 
Pose...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I see! Then let's combine it with my 
rice-washing pose to create a new form!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Hmm. But if a pigeon washes rice, wouldn't 
its feathers get completely soaking wet?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Mmh... That would be a pity. Understood, I 
shall master the Pigeon Pose as it is, 
then.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While maintaining the pretense of being 
taught, Gold City also managed to give 
Kawakami Princess the correct knowledge.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...Phew. That should do it for now.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for watching over me, Trainer. I 
knew you'd understand.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Gold City showed a smile, as if feeling 
relieved.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: But...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I-Is that so?! Goodness, how utterly 
embarrassing of me!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Still, that doesn't make all your hard 
work vanish. There's no need to be down on 
yourself...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Yes, indeed! I am quite glad we could 
recognize a mistake for what it is!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Ah, she's the type that bounces back 
quickly.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
...And so, I asked City-san to teach me 
about true yoga, and began my lessons.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
At times to the east, at times to the 
west, racing through pathless wilds—

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"H-Hold on a second?! What kind of 
development is this?"

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"—I figured if we slip in a narration like 
that, it'd give it more of an educational 
feel."

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Haaah... This isn't that kind of anime.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, so, um, City-san? If it's okay with 
you, could you teach me yoga...?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Sure. If you're fine with me, I'll show 
you the proper pose.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Oh, my, thank you very much! I look 
forward to working with you!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Gold City taught proper yoga to 
Kawakami Princess.
